name: land_use
note_zh: 临时示意几何。总体设计范围与三处重点区直接采用主办方场地包 provisional_boundaries.geojson 的临时替代边界；其余图层为本方案在该边界内的概念设计建议。全部要素 official_boundary=false，不得作为法定红线、审批依据或精确面积复算依据。；land_use 为 PROV-SITE-001 的精确剖分（无重叠、无缝隙、共享边坐标一致）
note_en: Provisional schematic geometry. The overall design area and the three key areas reuse the organizer's provisional_boundaries.geojson polygons verbatim; all other layers are this proposal's conceptual design inside that boundary. Every feature has official_boundary=false and must not be used as a statutory redline, approval basis, or precise area source. land_use is an exact partition of PROV-SITE-001 (no overlap, no gap, shared-edge coords).
